purpose_context: The example docsite currently uses synthetic content. This mission nests a genuine content showcase inside it, converting Book I of the CC-BY-SA-4.0 ars-rethorica (Aristotle's Rhetoric) into Markua-rich docsite pages, so prospective adopters see the toolkit exercised on real writing with real attribution, custom sections, footnotes, a native glossary, and reader personas.
purpose_tldr: Give the example site a real Markua-authored showcase converted from an open-license book, instead of placeholder prose.
source_description: Converts Book I of the CC-BY-SA-4.0 Markua book github.com/stijn-dejongh/ars-rethorica (revamp of the public-domain J.H. Freese 1926 translation of Aristotle's Rhetoric via the Perseus Project) into a nested content showcase inside example/.
